title: Is This a Normal Dip?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Judge whether each of three pilot performance series shows a normal implementation dip, a deep or late dip, or no dip, using a stated rule.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge whether each of three pilot performance series shows a normal implementation dip, an unusually deep or late dip, or no dip, applying the stated rule, and correctly judging all three.
prerequisites: The implementation dip, managing expectations, and the rule for a normal dip, from the section "Fullan, the Implementation Dip, and CBAM" in Chapter 16.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: Series A falls from 70 to 63 at month 3. What is the depth?
Series B bottoms at 54 in month 5. Why is it deep or late?
commonMisconceptions: Any drop below baseline means the pilot is failing
No drop means the pilot is going well
A dip that lasts a year is normal
assessmentOpportunities: Series A falls from 70 to 63 at month 3. What is the depth?
Series B bottoms at 54 in month 5. Why is it deep or late?
Does any drop below baseline mean a pilot is failing?
Does no drop mean the pilot is going well?

controls.name: Lowest month menus
controls.description: Choose the month of the lowest point, or none below the baseline.

controls.name: Judgment menus
controls.description: Choose one of the three judgments.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: Commits the answer for that series; one attempt.

controls.name: Show menu
controls.description: On narrow screens, picks which series to show.
